technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven for dependency management and resolution of jar version conflicts (U2).
Leverage Spring Boot profiles to implement backend strategy switching for stream repository (U6).
Adopt Spring Actuator to expose counter metrics endpoints as REST endpoints (U8).
Implement undeploy operation as a REST API call that stops and removes stream deployment state (U5).
Use Docker multi-stage builds to create minimal s-c-d images (U3).
Design module porting foundation based on existing Spring Cloud Stream module structure (U7).
assumptions: Developer is experienced with Spring Framework, Spring Cloud Data, and Spring Cloud Stream codebases.
Existing codebase follows standard Spring Boot project layout with Maven modules.
All user stories are for the same software increment and will be implemented sequentially.
No external dependencies other than those already present in the Spring ecosystem.
Docker Hub account and credentials are available for publishing images.
Testing environments (e.g., local JVM, Docker) are set up and working.
The PR referenced in U5 provides enough implementation details to estimate accurately.

activities.activity_description: Analyze the mechanism to include or exclude message bus/binding JARs at build time and design a fallback strategy when no binding is configured.
Add runtime dependency resolution to handle version conflicts between modules, e.g., different Spring Data versions, using Maven or custom classloader logic.
Create a Dockerfile, configure CI/CD to build and push the s-c-d image to DockerHub on each commit.
Record and produce a public screencast demonstrating the firehose-to-counter pipe functionality in Spring Cloud Stream.
Develop the undeploy REST endpoint and logic to stop and undeploy a running stream on a single JVM, ensuring consistency with job undeploy strategy.

activities.activity_name: Add profiles support to Admin application (U6)
activities.activity_description: Implement Spring profile-based backend strategy for the stream repository (e.g., 'local' uses in-memory, others use database).

activities.activity_name: Brainstorm and design module porting foundation (U7)
activities.activity_description: Collaborate to design the base infrastructure for porting Spring XD modules to Spring Cloud Stream modules, including module structure, SPI, and migration guide.
Add REST endpoints to expose counter (metrics) data using Spring Actuator for consumption by dashboards.
Perform end-to-end testing of all new features together, including regression tests and manual verification.
Write or update developer documentation, API references, and conduct code reviews for all changes.
